The '''Road to Glory''' was a road located on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Road to Glory appears as an area on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
